subject.title: improve(ci): preserve complete main validation during merge bursts

question: Should an authorized repository owner enforce `openclaw/ci-gate` through the proposed no-role-bypass default-branch ruleset and accept the resulting protected-main cleanup authority?
rationale: That repository ruleset and protected-main operational authorization are outside the PR diff and require an owner decision; source tests cannot establish that the intended branch-protection boundary is actually active.

options.title: Install ruleset and attach live proof
options.body: Require the no-bypass `openclaw/ci-gate` ruleset, then attach redacted protected-main evidence for the new concurrency and cache/cleanup paths before merge.

options.title: Narrow the PR to repository-only changes
options.body: Defer the cleanup workflow and ruleset-dependent rollout until an owner-sponsored operational plan is ready.

recommendation.title: Install ruleset and attach live proof
recommendation.body: Require the no-bypass `openclaw/ci-gate` ruleset, then attach redacted protected-main evidence for the new concurrency and cache/cleanup paths before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent merged cache-maintenance work and the current branch make steipete the clearest available routing candidate for the operational follow-through.
